claims.text: Either party may terminate the Web Site Hosting Agreement for convenience (without cause) on 30 days' written notice.

citations.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause at any time effective upon thirty (30) days' written notice.

claims.text: Termination does not release the Customer from paying amounts already due; the Customer must still make timely payments after termination for any reason.

citations.quote: no termination of this Agreement for any reason whatsoever shall relieve the Customer of the obligation to pay all amounts due to i-on and to make such payments on a timely basis.

claims.text: Separately from termination, either party may also decline to renew the agreement by giving notice not less than fifteen days before the end of the current term.
